advisories: Residual (PM ruling: advisory under the hooks threat model). A new variant whose position is the next free number, with no instance added, passes R6 (plant p7, green). The position functions cannot know the variant count, so the list's length is not tied to it. The compiler forces the position arm, and the doc comment above it (service_test.rs:985) says to add the instance. The plausible honest miss is a batch compile repair that fills the four non-exhaustive arms straight from the cargo JSON without reading that comment. A variant count derived on the enum would close it, at the cost of a new derive in production.

Carried from the last round: located_proof (service_test.rs:938) is a hand-written declaration of what validate_spans and relied cover. R6 cannot detect a fault placed in the wrong proof arm; the L1 keeps-failure cases are the evidence for those arms.
